newsitem.title: USA: MBNA says loan losses below industry level.
newsitem.headline: MBNA says loan losses below industry level.

text.p: MBNA Corp said on Tuesday that its loan losses continued to be significantly lower than industry levels.

The bank holding company said delinquency on total managed loans was four percent at September 30 and managed loan losses for the third quarter 1996 were 3.38 percent. Year-to-date, managed loan losses were 3.37 percent, including the sale of certain charged-off accounts, MBNA said.
Total managed loans at September 30 were $34.7 billion, a $4.2 billion increase over the second quarter 1996, it said.
